admin_guide.health: Use doctor and discovery read-only first; apply only allowlisted project-owned fixes with explicit approval.
admin_guide.lifecycle: Install, upgrade, and uninstall only strict provenance-bound native bundles through authenticated manifests and rollback-capable transactions.

architecture.authority: ARTIFEX Core alone derives canonical acceptance from immutable contracts, current evidence, gate policy, and explicit waivers.
architecture.canonical_truth: Filesystem and Git semantic state owned by Core; generated documentation, dashboards, packets, and vendor shims are non-canonical views.
architecture.interfaces: One semantic Application API is exposed through CLI and local JSON-lines MCP; integrations remain replaceable capability providers.

concepts.Acceptance Contract: Immutable criteria and bindings frozen before execution.
concepts.ChangeSet: Governed brownfield change lifecycle from proposal through verified application.
concepts.Evidence Ledger: Append-only, integrity-checked results bound to commit, contract, and Project Model fingerprints.
concepts.Execution Packet: Immutable, context-bounded work assignment with ownership and baseline fingerprints.
concepts.Project Model: Typed canonical project identity, Git state, artifacts, entities, provenance, dependencies, and status.

deployment.native: PyInstaller one-directory bundles for declared OS and architecture targets.
deployment.source: Locked Python environment for development and validation.

developer_guide.rule: Extend the semantic Application API and typed contracts before adding interface-specific behavior.

understanding.extensions: Extensions may contribute capability or evidence but cannot become canonical authority or expand privilege without policy approval.

implementation.milestones: M00 through M10 accepted; M11 self-host and release active

interfaces.claude: Standalone worktree-bound worker with portable semantic snapshots and authority-path protection.
interfaces.codex: Standalone worktree-bound worker with pre/post canonical checks and authority-path protection.
interfaces.hermes: Preferred capable integration with durable stage execution and restart continuity.
interfaces.manual: Portable packet and result exchange with explicit identity bindings.
interfaces.research: Provider-neutral ResearchRequest and evidence-only ResearchBundle; Pandora remains optional and non-canonical.

invariants: Core owns canonical state and acceptance transitions.
Generated views are never canonical inputs.
Executor completion is only a claim.
Contracts cannot be silently weakened after execution starts.
Evidence binds exact source, contract, and model fingerprints.
No native harness memory is required for continuity.
Self-improvement cannot expand privilege or mutate Core autonomously.
Secrets are scrubbed from evidence and generated context.
known_limitations: Native release qualification currently covers Windows X64, Linux X64, and macOS ARM64 only.
Native artifacts are provenance-attested but not publisher-signed or notarized.
Live optional-provider availability is environment dependent; DeepSeek may remain degraded when absent.
The dashboard is static and derived from repository evidence.
Windows native bundles intentionally reject symlink-bearing artifact inventories.
understanding.migration: Pre-acceptance artifact/install manifests are intentionally rejected rather than silently converted.

operations.state: .artifex and Git are sufficient to reconstruct canonical project state.

permissions.vendor_config: no mutation without explicit project-owned setup consent

project_history: M01-M03 established Project Model, workflow, validation, and compilation.
M04-M08 added integrations and controlled evolution.
M09 qualified beginner distribution on three operating systems.
M10 qualified optional DeepSeek and Pandora packs independently.
M11 adopts ARTIFEX and produces V1 release evidence.
understanding.purpose: Provide an agent-neutral control plane for durable project truth, governed execution, independent validation, continuity, distribution, and human and machine understanding.
understanding.recovery: Restore from Git and canonical .artifex state; harness conversation and provider-native memory are never required.

runbook.diagnose: Run read-only discovery and doctor, inspect canonical status, then check current evidence and Git identity.
runbook.recover: Use authenticated lifecycle rollback or a compensating ChangeSet; never erase audit/evidence history.

security.policy: Fail closed on stale identity, tampering, unsupported capability, privilege expansion, or canonical-state claims by an executor.

upgrade.policy: Plan first, bind exact source and installed manifest, back up authenticated files, verify after replacement, roll back on failure.

user_guide.beginner: Start from a plain-language goal; ARTIFEX creates project-owned state without requiring YAML, PATH, or MCP configuration.
user_guide.expert: Use semantic CLI/API/MCP operations, contracts, packets, and evidence directly.
user_guide.guided: Review plan-first effects, risk, rollback, and one-time confirmation tokens before mutations.

workflows.self_host: ARTIFEX adopts and changes its own repository through the same source-controlled contracts and authority boundaries used for other brownfield projects.
